t: 明朝朱允炆即位，是为建文帝。
te: Zhu Yunwen ascended the throne to the Ming dynasty to become the Jianwen Emperor.
dz: 明朝朱允炆即位，是为建文帝。
de: Zhu Yunwen ascended the throne to the Ming dynasty to become the Jianwen Emperor.

t: 凯利斯通战役由罗杰·莫蒂默(英语:Roger Mortimer)率领的英军,3月4日的厄尔与奥…
te: The Battle of Kellistown was fought on this day between the forces of the English led by Roger Mortimer, 4th Earl of Ma…
dz: 凯利斯通战役由罗杰·莫蒂默(英语:Roger Mortimer)率领的英军,3月4日的厄尔与奥比恩人和奥托勒斯人交战,由林斯特最有势力的酋长阿尔特·克·穆尔恰克·卡奥姆哈纳克指挥.
de: The Battle of Kellistown was fought on this day between the forces of the English led by Roger Mortimer, 4th Earl of March against the O'Byrnes and O'Tooles under the command of Art Óg mac Murchadha Caomhánach, the most powerful Chieftain in Leinster.

t: 在"萨利纳斯条约"中,立陶宛将萨莫吉蒂亚割让给特奥特尼克骑士.
te: In the Treaty of Salynas, Lithuania cedes Samogitia to the Teutonic Knights.
dz: 在"萨利纳斯条约"中,立陶宛将萨莫吉蒂亚割让给特奥特尼克骑士.
de: In the Treaty of Salynas, Lithuania cedes Samogitia to the Teutonic Knights.

t: 苏丹纳西尔-于·丁·迈赫穆德在德里的军队被帖木儿所击败.
te: Sultan Nasir-u Din Mehmud's armies in Delhi are defeated by Timur.
dz: 苏丹纳西尔-于·丁·迈赫穆德在德里的军队被帖木儿所击败.
de: Sultan Nasir-u Din Mehmud's armies in Delhi are defeated by Timur.
